The newsroom answer carried over from `proof/static-world-population/PALETTE.md` (the house colours of
`skills/splash/assets/root-template/NEWSROOM.example.md`); no subject convention applies to world population. Each
filed direction then draws in its own ground and accent, as `docs/design-base/directions/<id>.md` records them.

**One hue, two chromas.** The surface is the accent; while the unit is copied it steps back to a tint of the accent
mixed toward the direction's muted ink, floored at the non-text contrast against the ground, so the 1800 unit and its
copies — the same measure — carry the full accent. The level, the ring and the close-up's years are ink; the ticks and
the credit are muted, both from `deriveFurniture`.
